sections.title: RP2040, USB-C input and 3.3V power
sections.purpose: Power, flash and run the controller.
notes: USB-C sink with 5.1k on both CC pins; ESD, 27 ohm USB resistors, BOOTSEL/RUN buttons, 2MB QSPI and 12MHz crystal included.
AP2112 has 1uF input/output capacitors. Internal 1.1V regulator has 1uF each side. 130mA core peak plus button below 150mA allocation.
Use known regulated USB-C 5V source advertising at least 1.5A; no PD or CC sensing. No expansion headers.
Unreviewed block: RP2040 bare-chip USB motor-controller core.

reference.quote: The internal voltage regulator produces a 1.1 V supply from an input of 3.3 V.

sections.title: 5V motor driver
sections.purpose: Drive one small external brushed DC motor.
notes: DRV8833 bridge A to motor connector, unused bridge disabled. GP14 PWM IN1 and GP15 LOW IN2; LOW/LOW coast at boot and stop.
10nF VCP to VM, 2.2uF VINT to GND, 2x10uF ceramic plus 47uF bulk VM; 47k nSLEEP pullup.
0.51 ohm gives about 392mA nominal chopping; 505mA peak reservation is not a hard current limit. Qualify motor startup/stall, EMI and regeneration.
Unreviewed block: DRV8833 single brushed DC motor, qualified5V USB supply.

reference.quote: A low-ESR ceramic capacitor must be placed in between the VM and VCP pins.

sections.title: Single control button
notes: Active-low GP0 with 10k pullup; software debounce. Short presses cycle OFF,40%,70%,100%,OFF. Hold 800ms stops and consumes release. Power-up OFF.

drafts.title: GP0 application button
drafts.summary: Normally-open button to GND with 10k pullup; connect SIGNAL to RP2040 GP0, independent of BOOT/RESET.

datasheet.note: SPST-NO; schematic contacts 1 and 2. Extra catalog pad 3 treated as non-signal mechanical pad; verify footprint.

valueWhy.note: Maker requires 10k pullup; catalog confirms 10kΩ ±1%. Worst current 3.6V/9.9kΩ=0.364mA.

firmware.usage: Connect SIGNAL to RP2040 GP0 as digital input. Released=HIGH; pressed=LOW. Debounce in firmware. Typical supply current is held-button current; released current approximately zero. No boot/reset function.

requirements.plain: Includes an input for the control button.
